sample_unit: ACLR information subsections (ChatGPT 5.0 responses vs AAOS OrthoInfo text)

links.outcome: Readability grade level and reading ease of ChatGPT 5.0 ACLR patient information versus AAOS
links.effect: ChatGPT mean grade level 12.9 ± 1.6 (college level), reading ease 38.1 ± 4.1 (difficult), versus AAOS 10.2 ± 1.2 and 56.9 ± 14.2; p < 0.01, Cohen's d = 1.91.
links.quote: In contrast, the average reading grade level for ChatGPT's ACL reconstruction information was 12.9 ± 1.6, indicating a college-level reading requirement, with a reading ease score of 38.1 ± 4.1, falling in the "difficult" category.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT patient materials relative to appropriate patient reading level
links.effect: ChatGPT output required college-level reading (grade 12.9 ± 1.6); AAOS content was grade 10.2 ± 1.2; difference significant (p < 0.01).
links.quote: This study demonstrates that the readability of ChatGPT 5.0-generated information regarding ACLR is higher than that found on the AAOS OrthoInfo website, requiring a higher level of education for comprehension.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation measuring the readability/complexity of LLM-generated patient education materials compared to a standard medical website, but does not test a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
